steering.work_objective: On the existing small operations site, add a 用户信息收集 page surface where a user can fill in and submit their information and the system collects it. Concretely: add a collection form (required 姓名/name and 邮箱/email inputs, with client-side validation and a submit control) to the existing shared `web/index.html` document, wire its submission in `web/app.js` to the existing `POST /api/users` JSON endpoint so the record is persisted in the existing SQLite `users` table with schema-default `status`, show an inline confirmation or error message on the page, refresh the existing lists after a successful submission, and add form styling in `web/styles.css`. Preserve the admitted runtime form and entrypoint exactly: the application continues to run as `python server.py` on port 8080 (SITE_PORT/SITE_DATABASE_PATH overrides intact), serving the existing routes `/`, `/users`, `/customers`, `/orders`, `/help`, `/about`, the existing static assets, and the existing `/api/users`, `/api/customers`, `/api/orders` behaviors unchanged. No new route, endpoint, table, migration, container change, or authentication/authorization mechanism is introduced, and no external accounts or production data are connected.
